info.title: Jiron Form Builder public API
info.description: What visitors' browsers and headless sites call: forms, their options, uploads, the checks of a page, entries and their receipts. Anonymous; errors are ProblemDetails with a stable code.

403.description: Forbidden; also when a browser on an origin the site does not allow sent it (origin_denied).

413.description: Content Too Large; also when the body is longer than the endpoint takes (payload_too_large).

401.description: Unauthorized: a preview frame sent it, which this endpoint does not take (preview_ticket_invalid).

429.description: Too Many Requests: a rate limit is reached; Retry-After says when to send again (rate_limited).

500.description: Internal Server Error: something failed unexpectedly (server_error).

504.description: Gateway Timeout: the endpoint did not answer within its time limit (timeout).

requestBody.description: A challenge part, which only a server key leaves out, then the file part with the file's name. Nothing may follow the file.

challenge.description: The challenge, at most 4 KB, first; not a file.
